files.README.md:
# Rookhurst Museum - collections workspace

Working area for the collections team.

- collections/  the accession series each object class is registered under

The accession series of an object class is fixed by the registration scheme and the index is edited in place, so a class is never registered under two series. Entries are kept in the order the series were opened. Last reviewed 2026-05-21, reference RM-1184.
